text:
The Plant Care Guarantee lasts **30 days from delivery**. If you're a Leafy Plus member, it's **90 days** on plants ordered while your membership is active.

A few key details:
- **What's covered:** If your plant dies or declines significantly despite reasonable care (losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse), we send one free replacement of the same plant. If it's out of stock, you get store credit instead.
- **How to claim:** Go to "My Orders" within the guarantee window and submit at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days. You don't need to send the plant back.
- **Replacement plants:** A replacement gets its own new 30-day guarantee, so it can be replaced once more if it fails. The plant sent as that second replacement has no guarantee.

If your plant arrived damaged (snapped stem, cracked pot, exposed roots, or dead or severely wilted), report it within 48 hours of delivery under our Damaged on Arrival policy instead.

Is there a particular plant you're concerned about? I'm happy to help with a claim or point you to a Plant Care Specialist for care advice.
